title: Kranti Kumar Singh v. State of U.P.
coram: Dilip B. Bhosale, C.J. and Yashwant Varma, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; fresh 4.4 application to be decided in two weeks
headnote: On the petitioner's request, a writ seeking a fresh electricity connection was disposed with liberty to apply again under clause 4.4 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The concerned authority must consider and decide any such application within two weeks of presentation. No merits finding on entitlement to connection was made.
facts: Kranti Kumar Singh approached the Allahabad High Court seeking a fresh electricity connection. His counsel told the Division Bench that the petitioner would be satisfied if allowed to apply again to the third respondent with the documents contemplated by clause 4.4 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and if that authority were directed to consider the application within a fixed time. Counsel for respondents 3 and 4 and the State Standing Counsel were heard.

holding_units.holding: A consumer seeking a fresh electricity connection may apply afresh to the concerned authority with the documents contemplated by clause 4.4 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. If such an application is made, the authority shall consider and decide it within two weeks of presentation. The writ was disposed on those terms without directing that a connection be granted.
holding_units.flag: Cited as Section 4.4 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

not_decided.point: entitlement to a fresh electricity connection on merits
not_decided.note: Disposed on the petitioner's request for liberty to apply afresh with a time-bound consider-and-decide direction; no finding on whether connection was due.
